excerpts.title: Open runs recovery
excerpts.why: Every open runs the full recovery: lock, MANIFEST, orphan sweep, hint-first keydir load and torn-tail truncation.
text: // Open opens or creates the store in dir, applying opts in order. It acquires dir/LOCK (ErrLocked on
// contention, skipped WithReadOnly), sweeps trash/, reads the MANIFEST (rebuilt WithRepair, else ErrCorrupt
// when bad), moves unlisted segments to trash/, loads the keydir hint-first, truncates a torn tail on the
// active segment, and starts the flusher and auto-compactor. See docs/PLAN.md "Open / recovery procedure".
return nil, errors.New("kvlite: Open: empty dir")

excerpts.title: Torn tail or corruption
excerpts.why: Tells a torn tail, safe to truncate, from a bogus length with intact records behind it, which is corruption and never truncated.

excerpts.title: Append and rotate
excerpts.why: Rotates before a write would overflow the segment, and a failed append poisons the store until a reopen truncates the partial record.
text: // appendLocked writes one encoded record to the active segment, rotating first when it would push the
